messages.text: Your refund proposal is eligible for BRL 93.50. Please confirm it using the button on the proposal card; typing “yes” here won’t confirm it. After you confirm, a staff member will review the request.

The customer confirmed request prop-95d5ef7ee6b640c7, but a staff member rejected it, so nothing will be paid. The staff member gave this reason for the customer: "The returned bag has a stain on the strap."
A staff member rejected the refund request because they found a stain on the bag’s strap. No refund will be paid.
I never used the bag; I only took it out of the box. I don’t accept this decision. Could I speak to a person?
